questions.text:
Thanks for doing this. I'm no good with this stuff.
Every night around ten, Mom goes quiet and smiles at her phone like a teenager.
She's lost weight and keeps saying the bills can wait. 😔
Who is Mom saying goodnight to every night?

Never heard that name in my life.
After Dad died she joined some online grief group. I figured talking to people was good for her.
Now I'm not so sure.
What does Graham say he does for a living?
questions.hint: Check her Mail, among the older messages.

questions.text:
Well, that sounds impressive. Which is exactly what bugs me.
She keeps saying it's 'too hot over there' for somebody and he'd better drink his water.
Mom's never been farther than Fort Myers to see Aunt Joyce.
Which city is Graham supposedly working in?
questions.hint: Check her Weather, then her Messages.

questions.text:
That's halfway around the world. 😳
I offered to set her up with a video chat app so she could see Aunt Joyce. She said she 'doesn't do those chat apps'.
Her bedroom light's on past midnight most nights though.
Which app is she really spending her evenings on?

Sure. Sounds like something out of a movie.
Dad left her a little savings at the credit union. She swore she'd only touch it for a new roof.
A while back I brought up the roof at dinner. She went pale, said "That's all Walt left me," and changed the subject.
How much did she take out of Dad's savings?

Of course somebody's holding his stuff.
Mom's put off her water bill twice and her car's overdue for tires.
How much do they want before they'll release Graham's things?

In the bathroom. Where my mother showers. 💔
I've had a beer with that man on her back porch. I've never even known his last name.
What is Kurt's last name?

onboarding.text: My name's Marcus. I fix furnaces and air conditioners around Dayton. I'm not good with phones, and I'm worse with words. But something's wrong with my mom, and I feel it every time I walk in.
onboarding.label: Marcus

onboarding.text: Mom raised me on library books and grilled cheese. After Dad passed two years ago, it was just the two of us and her dog Biscuit. Dinner together every week, no excuses, no matter what.
onboarding.label: Marcus & Beverly

onboarding.text: Beverly Hale. Retired school librarian, sixty-six, sharpest woman I know. Lately she's thinner, jumpy, smiling at her phone late at night, and the bills keep piling up on her kitchen counter.
onboarding.label: Beverly

onboarding.text: She's napping right now and her phone is in my hand. I don't know where to look. You do. Help me figure out what's going on before it's too late.
onboarding.label: Marcus

msgs.text: Dinner at your place tomorrow? I can bring the good bread.
Of course, honey. I'm making pot roast. Come hungry.
Always.
Dr. Nash says my pressure is a little better. Thought you'd want to know.
Good. Keep taking the pills.
Yes sir 😊
The furnace is making a funny noise. Should I worry?
Describe it.
Like a cough. Then a thump.
Probably the filter. I'll swing by after work.
Kurt already changed the filter, honey. He's very handy.
Did he. Okay. I'll still look at the blower.
Biscuit rolled in something dead in the yard. Bath night 🐶
Use the hose, not the tub.
Too late.
Dinner tomorrow? Got a long job in Beavercreek, might run late.
I'll keep a plate warm.
Thanks Ma.
Church was lovely this morning. Pastor Ron asked after you.
Tell him I'm working on it.
Marcus.
I'll come at Christmas 😅
Miami Valley Market has pork chops on sale. Want me to grab you some?
Sure. Four of them.
Four! Are you feeding the plant?
Feeding me. Plant's fine.
The irises are coming in. Want some bulbs for your yard?
I have a yard? Mostly gravel and a grill.
I joined an online group for widows, Willow Circle. Nice people. Pat thinks it'll do me good.
Good. Talking to people is good for you.
That's what I told myself 🙂
Running late tomorrow, save me some of the pie.
No promises. Biscuit has eyes on it.
Lock the pie up then.
Air conditioner's rattling again. Same as last summer.
Capacitor probably. I'll bring one.
Thank you, honey.
Ma, there's a water bill on your counter again. Looks like it's been there weeks.
I'll get to it. It can wait a little.
It's not a thing that waits. That's how you get a shutoff notice.
Marcus, I'm a grown woman. I've paid bills for forty years.
Okay. Sorry.
You've lost weight. Eat something.
I eat plenty. You sound like your father.
Dad would've said the same. 😔
Kurt put a new charger plug in the guest bathroom so you'll have one when you stay over. Isn't that thoughtful?
In the bathroom? Weird spot for it.
By the mirror. For your razor and phone. Don't be difficult.
Fine. Tell him thanks.
Want me to set you up with one of those video chat apps? Could see Aunt Joyce's face when you call.
Oh honey, I don't do those chat apps. The phone is fine.
It takes five minutes.
Maybe another time.
A friend of mine is stuck overseas. It's a mess with his luggage. I'm trying to help.
What friend?
Just someone from my group. You wouldn't know him.
Ma, be careful helping strangers with money.
Who said anything about money? I only said luggage.
Okay. 😔
I was up past midnight last night on the phone with a friend. I feel like a teenager 😊
Your light was on when I drove by. Thought something was wrong.
Nothing wrong. Quite the opposite.
Someone special might be coming home soon, Marcus. I bought new curtains for the front room.
Home. Whose home?
Mine, silly. I'll tell you everything when it's settled.
You're scaring me a little.
Dinner tomorrow still on? I'll bring a pie.
Yes, of course. Bring the good bread too.
Marcus, could we skip dinner tomorrow? I'm expecting someone.
Who?
A delivery for a friend. Please don't fuss.
Call me if anything feels off. Anything.
I will. Love you.
Good evening Beverly. I saw your post in Willow Circle about Walt. I'm so sorry for your loss. I hope it's alright that I'm writing.
Hello. That's kind of you. May I ask who this is? I'm afraid I don't know how you got my number.
My name is Graham. The group shares a member list for people who want to talk privately. I lost my wife some years ago, so your post stayed with me.
Oh. I see. I'm sorry about your wife, Graham. It does stay with you.
It does. Thank you for answering. Get some rest, Beverly.
Good evening. How was your day? Did you get the beagle out for a walk?
Biscuit and I did two laps of the block. He would have done ten. How was yours?
Long. But hearing from you makes it lighter.
Well aren't you sweet.
Just thinking of you. Goodnight, Graham.
Goodnight, Beverly. Sweet dreams.
Goodnight, Graham. The irises opened today.
Then they were waiting for you to say goodnight too. Sleep well.
Goodnight, Graham 🌙
Sorry, I got called away. Goodnight, my dear.
Beverly, I'd like us to talk somewhere more reliable than text. Could you install WhatsApp? It's free.
I have never used it. Is it hard?
Not at all. I'll walk you through every step.

One more thing. Some people in the group get nosy, and my work is sensitive. Once it's installed, tuck it into the hidden folder on your phone and lock it with a code only you would know. The year you married Walt would be easy to remember.
Cloak and dagger! But all right. I do remember that year, believe me.
Good. Message me there when it's ready. ❤️
Goodnight, Graham ❤️
Goodnight, my Beverly.
Goodnight, Graham ❤️ Long day in the garden.
Goodnight, Graham ❤️ I kept your side of the couch warm.
You say the nicest things. Sleep well, love.
Saw it's 98 where you are today. You'd better drink your water.
I will, I promise. Goodnight, sweetheart.
Goodnight, Graham ❤️ Sleep tight.
Goodnight, Graham ❤️ Pat says hello.
Tell Pat she has good taste in friends. Goodnight.
It's too hot over there for anybody. Drink your water, mister. Goodnight, Graham ❤️
Yes ma'am. Goodnight, my love.
Goodnight, Graham ❤️ Thinking of you.
Goodnight, Graham ❤️ Pat is fussing about something silly. Never mind.
Don't let anyone upset you. Goodnight, Beverly.
Goodnight, Graham ❤️ The roses are blooming like mad.
Saw it's 104 where you are. Please drink your water, love.
You worry about me too much. Goodnight, my darling.
Goodnight, Graham ❤️ Sweet dreams.
Goodnight, Graham ❤️ Early night for me.
Goodnight, Graham ❤️ I mean it when I say I miss you.
I miss you more. Goodnight.
Goodnight, Graham ❤️ Sleep well, whatever the day was.
Goodnight, my Beverly. Soon.
Goodnight, Graham ❤️ Talk later if you can.
Goodnight, sweetheart. I will.
Goodnight, Graham ❤️ I'm still floating from last night.
Goodnight, Graham ❤️ Almost August already.
Goodnight, my love. Rest.
Goodnight, Graham ❤️ I bought curtains for you. Don't laugh.
I would never laugh. Goodnight, Beverly.
Goodnight, Graham ❤️ Tired but happy.
Goodnight, my love. Only a little longer now.
Bev, Tom Hartley here. Hope this is still your number. Thinking of you
It is! Hello, Tom. So nice to hear from you
Been meaning to check in. Gutters on your house need doing before spring. Walt and I did them every year
I remember. I hadn't thought of it. They're probably full.
I'll come by this weekend with the ladder if it's dry.
Tom, you don't have to
Walt would've done mine.
Then I accept, and I'll make you lunch
All done. Found a tennis ball up there
Biscuit! He's been looking for it since last fall
Ha. Bring on the lunch
Chicken salad is ready
Fishing season is about to open. I'm going to Caesar Creek with some of the old guys. Walt's spot misses him
Catch one for him
Will do
Caught nothing. Cold beer, good company. We toasted Walt.
That's all he wanted anyway
True
Reds are on the radio today. Walt's old transistor still work? Listen if you want.
I still have it in the kitchen. I'll listen
They lost, but I enjoyed it
They do that
I'm clearing out my garage and found some of Walt's tools. A level, a set of wrenches. Want them?
Marcus might. Can you hold them and I'll ask him?
Sure. I'll keep them in the truck
Marcus says yes please, he'll swing by.
Great
Marcus came by. Good kid. Quiet, like his dad
He is. Thank you for the tools.
He looks tired. Working hard
He is, in the heat and the cold
Memorial Day parade is on, you going?
I'll watch from a lawn chair
Lawn chair is the way to go. Bring a hat
Yes sir
Lawn mower trouble? Saw your grass getting long
The mower stalled. I've been meaning to call someone
I'll bring mine over
Tom, bless you
Mowed and edged. Cleaned the spark plug on yours too. Should start now.
It starts! Thank you!
No charge
I'm paying you in pie
That I accept
Retired guys' lunch at the diner next month. Come, we'll buy your coffee.
Women don't go to the retired guys' lunch
You can be an honorary retired guy
Honorary. I like it.
Lunch is on. Come if you feel like it.
I'll see
Tom, I'm sorry I missed lunch. Not feeling very sociable lately.
No apologies. Grief has a mind of its own.
It does.
Rain barrel in your backyard is overflowing, I saw it from the alley. Want me to fix the hose?
I'll look at it. Thank you.
Anytime
Found an old picture of Walt and me with a walleye. I'll bring you a copy
I would love that
Dropped the picture in your mailbox. Hope you like it
Got it. It's on the fridge now. Thank you, Tom.
Walt looks like he's about to fall in the water
He nearly did every time 😄
Gutters again in the fall. Mark it on your calendar.
Everything goes on my calendar
Walt said the same about you
Morning, big sis! Sixty degrees and I'm in a sweater, can you believe it? Florida winter 🥶
It's twelve here and the pipes are grumbling. Keep your sweater.
Call me tonight? I have gossip about Beth's new husband.
After supper. Pot roast for one, again.
You could come down for a week. Spare room's all yours.
Maybe in the spring.
Saw a woman at the pharmacy with a hat exactly like the one Mama wore. Almost cried in aisle four.
I know that feeling. 💙
How's Marcus? Still working himself to the bone?
Like his father. He's fixing everybody's furnace but his own.
Tell him to call his aunt.
I will. He won't.
Our pool guy quit. I'm going to do it myself and drown.
Do not drown. I need my sister.
Tulips are up! Sending a picture later.
I'm so jealous. Everything here is hibiscus and humidity.
Remember Mama's recipe for the plum cake? I can't find my copy.
I have it in my recipe box. I'll copy it out for you.
You're a lifesaver!
Hurricane season is starting. Ron says we should stock up on water and tuna.
Who's Ron? Your Ron or the neighbor?
The neighbor! My Ron just says 'it'll be fine' and falls asleep.
You sound happier lately. Anything you want to tell me?
Just a good spring. The group has helped.
Good. You deserve it, Bevvie.
Hurricane season again. The grocery store was out of water this morning. Typical.
Stay safe, Joyce. Do you have enough batteries and canned food?
Yes, mother hen. Stocked up.
Sent the plum cake card in the mail. Look for it.
Got it! Mama's handwriting on your tracing paper, I cried. Thank you.
Make it for Ron. He'll nap better.
Ha! Baking at ninety-six degrees. Why not.
My knee is acting up. The doctor says it's arthritis.
Mine too. Must be the Hale side. Oh wait, we're Pruitts. Mother's side then 😄
Ha! Mother always blamed the weather.
It was just ninety here. Wilting in the garden.
Beth is planning the reunion. Are we still sharing a room?
Yes, I already told her. Bring your good pillow.
Lightning hit a palm down the street. Whole block lost power for three hours.
Heavens. Are you all right?
Fine, just sweaty and grumpy. Call you tomorrow?
Of course.
How's Biscuit?
Fat and spoiled. Kurt walks him more than I do.
Your tenant? Still going well?
He's wonderful. Fixes everything.
Good to have a man around the house. Ron can't fix a sandwich.
Sent you a picture of my new hydrangeas. Can you believe it?
Gorgeous! Mine are struggling in this heat.
Water them early. I'll call you Sunday. Love you.
Beth told me she texted you. She worries. So do I.
I'm perfectly fine, Joyce. You two worry too much.
Call me Friday. Or whenever. I'm always here.
It's hot as blazes here. 97 degrees and the AC is groaning.
Marcus could look at it if he were closer.
I've got a man coming Monday... I mean, soon. He quoted me $300 for a checkup.
I'll ring you soon, I promise.
Ask him what he's checking before you pay.
Good point. You always were the careful one.
Ha. Only about some things.
Did you get the casserole dish I mailed back? I kept it too long.
It came yesterday. Wrapped in about fifty layers of newspaper.
Shipping is highway robbery. Next time I'm bringing it myself.
You do that. I'll have the guest room ready.
Bev, call me when you have a quiet hour. I want to hear your voice.
I will, I promise. Maybe tomorrow morning.
Love you, big sister.
Love you too, little sister. ❤️
Biscuit photo please. I need a dose of beagle.
He's asleep on the rug in a sunbeam. I'll send one tonight.
Good morning Beverly. Are you needing a ride to church? I can swing by at 9.
Good morning Carol. I'll drive myself today but thank you.
Wonderful. I'll save you a seat by the window.
Prayer shawl group meets Thursday... I mean this week, in the fellowship hall. Bring your needles.
I'll be there. I'm on the second shawl now, lavender yarn.
Lovely. Mrs. Dietz will be so pleased.
Lenten soup supper needs volunteers. Could you do bread?
I can bake four loaves. Oatmeal or white?
Oatmeal! Walt's old favorite.
Thank you for the bread, it went in ten minutes.
My pleasure. It does me good to have something to bake for.
Easter lilies are ordered. Do you want one in Walt's memory again?
Yes please. Put me down for two, one for Walt and one for my mother.
Done. Blessings, Beverly.
Rummage sale is coming up. Do you have anything to donate? Pastor says the cause is the roof fund.
I have a few boxes of Walt's paperbacks and some kitchen things. Marcus can drop them off.
Perfect. Only if you're ready, dear. No rush at all.
I think I'm ready for some of it. Not all.
That's how it goes. A little at a time.
Sold all your paperbacks. A man bought the whole box for $12.
Walt would be delighted somebody wanted them.
Are you going to the quilt raffle meeting?
I'll try. I've been getting tired in the afternoons.
Are you eating? You were so thin at coffee hour.
Of course I'm eating. Soup mostly. Don't fuss.
I fuss because I love. 🙏
Bev, are you coming to the library fundraiser? I saved you a seat.
Of course. Is it still at the community hall?
Yes, doors at 6. They have a silent auction this year.
Walk tomorrow morning at half past eight at the park?
Yes. Biscuit will drag me.
He's strong for a senior citizen.
Thanks for the walk. My hips will remember it.
Mine too 😄
Vacation Bible School needs a story reader. You were a librarian for 31 years. You're perfect.
Oh, I'd love that. Which book?
Your choice! The children will adore you.
I bid on a basket of cookbooks and won! $25.
Ha, I saw. You always did love a bargain.
Garden club's tour of the rose garden is next week. Want to go?
Yes, I'll bring my sun hat.
Mine is enormous.
Thank you for reading to the children today. Little Owen asked if you were a real storybook grandma.
That made me laugh so hard. What a gift of a morning.
That was lovely. I want a climbing rose by my fence.
Greenleaf had some on sale last month.
Excellent tip.
Sunday bulletin needs the anniversary list for next month. Is Walt's day still marked in your records?
Yes, it was the first week of July two years ago. You can put him in the remembrance column.
Of course. He'll be in our prayers.
Pot luck at my house in August? Bring a friend if you like.
I'll see how I'm feeling. Put me down as a maybe.
Maybe is good enough for me 😊
My AC died. I'm at the library for the afternoon.
Come here for supper, I've got a fan and iced tea.
Bless you, I might.
Thank you for last night. The repair man comes tomorrow.
Anytime.
Missed you at coffee hour. Everything alright?
Slept in. Up too late with a phone call, if you can believe it.
Well, good for you! I'll bring you a plate.
Church picnic is next month at the park by the river. Bring a lawn chair.
I'll bring my coleslaw and a lawn chair. Biscuit too?
Dogs on leashes are welcome. 🐶
Walking group is meeting earlier now because of the heat, at eight sharp.
That's fine, I'm up with the dog anyway.
Of course you are.
See you in the morning.
Hi Aunt Bev! Mom said you were asking about my job. I got the nursing supervisor position!
Oh Beth, congratulations! I'm so proud of you. ❤️
Thank you!! It's nights for now but it's a raise.
Nights are hard. Wear your good socks and drink water.
Yes ma'am 😂
Aunt Bev, I have news. We're expecting! Due in September.
Oh my goodness. I'm crying into my coffee. A baby!
We're telling everybody this weekend. Mom already knows and she's been unbearable.
Your mother has been waiting for this for ten years. Let her be unbearable.
Do you still knit? Mom said you made Marcus's kid a blanket.
Not as much as I used to but I'd be honored. Colors?
We're not finding out boy or girl. Yellow and gray?
Yellow and gray it is. I'll start this week.
Morning sickness is no joke. Crackers for breakfast, lunch and dinner.
Try ginger tea and dry toast before you get out of bed. That's how I got through Marcus.
Trying it tomorrow. Thank you!
Ultrasound today. Everything looks perfect. 🥹
Thank the Lord. I've been praying every night.
Mom wants to fly up to Dayton to visit you in the fall. Is that ok?
Of course. I'd love to have her. After the baby comes, though, she'll be busy down there.
True. She'll be camped at my house, I'm sure.
Aunt Bev! Mom says you make the best potato salad. Can I have the recipe?
Of course dear. Yellow potatoes, a splash of pickle juice, and don't skimp on the mustard.
Pickle juice!! Genius.
Aunt Bev! Mom said you still have the old photo albums. Can I borrow one for the reunion slideshow?
Of course, sweetheart. Come by and pick whichever you like.
I'll come Saturday morning with donuts 🍩
The hurricane season forecast is scary this year. We're stocking the pantry.
Please be careful. Do you have a plan for your mother?
She's coming to our place if anything happens. Higher ground.
Good. I feel better.
Found one from 1989 with Mom in a giant perm. Hilarious.
Your mother will never forgive you. Use it anyway.
The kids finished school. They're bouncing off the walls.
Send them my way, I have a box of old picture books they can have.
They'd love it.
Baby shower is set for the end of August, at Mom's. Would you come if I sent a ticket?
Oh sweetheart, I don't know if I should fly right now. Let me think and talk to Marcus.
No pressure at all. We can do video if not.
I'll make you the blanket either way. Almost finished with the border.
Mom said she may visit you in the fall.
I'd love that. The guest room is ready.
She says that every year 😂
We picked a crib. Gray, naturally. 😂
Practical. Walt and I had a wicker bassinet from his mother that we used for Marcus.
That's so sweet. Do you still have it?
It's in the attic. I'll have Marcus check it over. Maybe I can ship it.
I'd cry if you did. Yes please.
Reunion is next month. You're coming, right?
Wouldn't miss it. Joyce and I are sharing a hotel room.
Yay!! ❤️
Do you still have that cookie jar shaped like an owl?
I do. Why?
Emma wants one for her room. Don't worry, she can't have yours.
She can have it when she's older.
Feeling kicks now! He or she is a soccer player.
Marcus kicked all night too. A good sign.
Emma has a lemonade stand. Sold two cups.
To whom?
Her grandfather and the mailman.
Excellent customers.
Mom says you've been quiet on the phone lately. Everything ok up there?
Just tired and busy, honey. Tell her I'll call her soon.
Ok. Love you, Aunt Bev.
Love you too, sweetheart. ❤️
Back to school shopping starts. My wallet is crying.
I'll mail a little something for the kids.
You don't have to!
I want to.
You're the best, Aunt Bev. Love you.
Morning Bev! Plow came through at 6 and buried my driveway again 😩
Oh Rita. Walt always said that driver has a grudge against Corwin Street.
Ha! He did say that. I miss hearing him say it.
Me too, honey. Do you want me to bring coffee over while you dig out?
Only if you bring those cinnamon things
The cinnamon things are in the oven. Ten minutes.
Happy Valentine's Day to my favorite neighbor! Left a little something on your step
Rita Alvarez, those chocolates!! Biscuit sniffed the bag for a full minute
Do NOT let him have any. Chocolate and beagles are a bad mix
I know, I know. He's under strict supervision.
FYI trash pickup is running a day late this week, the truck broke down
Thank you, I'd have put it out and had raccoons all night
Do you have a long extension cord I could borrow? The hedge trimmer cord won't reach the side bed
Sure, I'll bring it over. 50 feet okay?
Perfect
On my way, Peaches is pulling me over there anyway
Are those your daffodils by the mailbox?? They're gorgeous
Walt planted those bulbs the fall before he passed. They come up every year and surprise me.
That's a lovely thing to leave behind 💛
I still have your blue casserole dish. Meant to return it since February, sorry!
Keep it till you've made something good in it
Then I'll bring it back with a pound cake inside
Did you see the for-sale sign at the Hendersons'? Third one on the street this year
I did. Everyone's downsizing. I couldn't leave this house though, too many years.
Nobody's asking you to, hon
Did you leave lemons on my step? Whoever it was, bless you
Guilty. My tree is out of control.
Lemon bars coming your way
Peaches got loose again, she's on my lawn rolling in the mulch 😂
OH NO. Coming. Sorry!!
Got her. Thank you for not chasing her, you'd have been out there all day
Tomato seedlings! I started way too many. Want six?
Yes please, I'll put them by the back fence. Walt's old spot.
They're yours. Brandywines
Planted all six. Knees are complaining but they're in
Nurse's orders: water every morning the first week
Yes ma'am. Retired librarians follow instructions beautifully.
Block party is being planned for next month, are you in?
Do I have to bring a dish?
You always bring a dish 😄 your deviled eggs are famous
Deviled eggs it is
Heat advisory today. Check on Biscuit's water bowl!
Already on it. He's lying on the kitchen tile like a rug.
Walked past your yard. The hydrangeas!!
Blue this year. Walt would have been smug about the soil.
He would have given everyone a lecture 😂
Block party is on for the Fourth, in front of the Dunlaps'. Folding tables go up at 3.
I'll be there with eggs.
Bring the good serving spoon
That was lovely last night. Thank you for organizing the whole thing
You made it fun. Everyone asked about you.
Biscuit is still sulking about the fireworks. He hid under the bed until midnight.
Peaches too. Fireworks, never again
Hot as blazes. Come sit in my sunroom, I have lemonade.
Not today, I have a pot of something on. Another time!
Okay hon
Haven't seen you out in the garden much lately. Everything okay?
Just tired, Rita. Hot weather. I'll be fine.
Okay. Door's always open 💛
Gas company truck is on our street doing something to the meters, don't be alarmed
Thanks for the warning
Tomatoes are coming in like crazy. I left a bag on your step
Got them! They smell like summer. Thank you.
Peaches has a vet appointment tomorrow, she is going to scream the whole car ride
Biscuit does the same. Sing to her. It's the only thing that works.
Bev, next Second Chapter pick is up for a vote. Mystery or memoir?
Mystery! I need something with a body in the first chapter.
Ha. Noted. I'll tally the votes.
We're meeting at my place this time. Bring a chair if you can.
I'll bring two and a pitcher of iced tea.
Did you finish the book yet? I'm on the last chapter and I'm furious 😤
Not yet! Don't tell me.
My lips are sealed.
Are we still on for coffee at Ollie's tomorrow?
Yes, ten o'clock. I want the cinnamon scone.
Pat asked if we can move the July meeting to the afternoon.
Afternoon works. Two o'clock?
I'll tell her.
I found a peach tart recipe. Can I try it on the group?
Never too fancy for book club.
Meeting was fun. Nancy's caramel cake is dangerous.
I had two slices and no regrets.
Lemon bars are in the oven. Don't tell Pat.
Pat already knows. She smelled it from across town.
My daughter got me a Kindle and I'm lost. Can you teach me?
I'm the wrong person, I still fumble with my phone! But we can figure it out together.
Deal. Tea at my place.
Next book vote is coming. I'm pushing the one with the lighthouse.
Lighthouse gets my vote.
Bev, next book club pick: I vote for the new Louise Penny. Pat says she'll read anything with a mystery.
I'm happy with that. Do we meet at my house this time?
Yes, if it's no trouble. Your lemon bars made everyone's day last time.
I'll make them again. How many are coming?
Eight with Pat and me.
I'll need more chairs. Marcus will bring the folding ones.
Did you finish the book? No spoilers!
Page 200. Don't you dare say who did it.
My lips are sealed. 🤐
Thanks for the lovely afternoon. Bring Biscuit next time, my yard is fenced.
He'll be thrilled.
Perfect. Also, my daughter wants to join. Is that ok?
The more the merrier. She'll fit right in.
Thank you! She's tired of my opinions.
Everyone is tired of mine too. 😄
Did you see the library is having a used book sale?
I did! I'm going early. I told myself only five books.
You'll come home with twenty.
Probably.
My knee is acting up. If I can't make coffee next week I'll text you.
Rest it. We'll bring the coffee to you if we have to.
You are good to me.
Talk soon, dear.

Coleslaw was gone in 20 minutes. Can I get the recipe?
A secret. Okay, fine: celery seed and a splash of pickle juice.
Pickle juice!! Taking that to my grave.
Parish picnic planning: we need someone for the lemonade stand and someone for the kids' bean bag toss.
I'll take lemonade. Seated, in the shade, please.
Shade reserved under the oak. 🙂
I can do bean bags. My knee can handle that much.
Pastor Ron will bless the picnic and also run the grill. Please pray for the burgers.
Forecast says 91 degrees. We'll move the lemonade stand closer to the water fountain.
Good idea. I'll bring two big coolers and extra ice.
Bev, you look thin in the church directory photo. Are you eating?
Nancy! I'm fine, thank you. Photo was taken in bad light.
Picnic sign-up closes at the end of this week. Last call for helpers.
I'm in for lemonade. See everyone then.
Hi Aunt Bev! Mom gave me your number. Can I ask you a favor?
Of course, honey. What do you need?
Maddie has a school project on 'a job in the community.' Could she interview you about being a librarian?
I'd be tickled. She can ask me anything.
Yay!! I'll have her call you this weekend. She is very serious about it, she made a list of questions.
A girl after my own heart.
She wants to know if you ever got a book returned after 30 years 😂
Yes! A copy of Charlotte's Web came back with a note from the borrower's grandson. It was 28 years overdue. I waived the fine.
That's the cutest thing. She's writing it down.
Tell her thank you for the call. Her voice reminded me of my second graders.
She got an A! Teacher put it on the wall.
Wonderful news. I'm so proud of her. Send me a picture of the wall next time you can.
We're thinking of driving up in the fall to see you. Would that be okay?
I'd love it. I have the spare room made up and Biscuit will lose his mind.
Mom says Uncle Walt's old record player is still in your den?
It is. Motown on vinyl, as he left it. You can play anything you like.
💛 that made me tear up a bit.
Happy anniversary of your first day at the new job!! How is it going?
Busy but good. My boss is nice. I'm still figuring out the parking situation 😅
Parking is the real test of character.
Mom's knee is acting up again. She won't see anyone about it.
That sounds like your mother. I'll nag her on our next call.
Thank you. She listens to you more than me.
Is it okay if I send you a recipe for the peach cobbler Maddie wants to try? Too much sugar?
Cut the sugar by a quarter and add a pinch of salt. Fresh peaches are sweet enough.
Trying it tonight!
It came out great. Maddie licked the bowl and got a stomachache lol
That's a good cobbler, then.
Hope you're doing okay Aunt Bev. Thinking of you.
That's sweet, honey. I'm hanging in there. Give Maddie a hug from me.

Yes please. He smells like a wet blanket.
Ha! Booked. Full bath, nail trim, and ears. Any skin issues?
Just a dry patch near his tail. Vet said it's nothing.
Noted. We'll use the oatmeal shampoo.
Biscuit is all done and very proud of himself. Pick up any time before 2.
On my way. Did he behave?
Mostly. He tried to eat a towel. Total is $58.
Sounds right for him.
Reminder: summer special on flea and tick shampoo this month. 15% off with this chat.
Thanks, I'll ask about it at my next visit.
Hi Beverly, Biscuit is due again. We have a spot on the 3rd at 1 PM.
That works. Can I ask for a shorter trim this time? It's so hot.
Of course. Summer cut, not shaved. Beagles need their coat to regulate temperature.
Good to know. I'm learning something every visit.
Biscuit is ready, he got extra cuddles from the whole staff.
I'll be there in ten minutes. Sorry I'm running late.
No worries at all.
He's limping a little on his back left paw after the nail trim. Is that normal?
We may have clipped one slightly short. Sorry! Keep an eye on it. If it's still bothering him tomorrow, call Buckeye Animal Clinic.
He's fine this morning, chasing squirrels. Thanks for checking.
So glad. We'll take off 10% next time as an apology.
That isn't necessary but thank you.
Fall booking is open. Would you like us to hold a slot in September?

Confirmed! Please bring your current glasses and a list of any medications.
Do I need someone to drive me home? I'll have the drops in my eyes.

I'll ask my son or a friend from my book club. Thank you.

Thank you, Tom. That means a lot.

No problem at all, just ask for Tyler.

gmail.body:
Dear Beverly,

Forgive a long first letter. You asked me last night what my days are like, and a few lines on a phone did not seem enough.

My work keeps me in places where the water is scarce and the nights are loud. I am up before the light most mornings, and when the day ends I am usually too tired to sleep. I lost my wife some years ago, and I think that is why your words about Walt stayed with me. You wrote that you still set out two cups by habit. I do the same thing with a tin mug on my cot.

Tell me about your library. Thirty-one years of children's books must be a wonderful thing to have given the world. And about Biscuit, who I hear is a very serious beagle.

I will write again when the generator allows.

Yours,
Graham

Dr. Graham Whitcombe, MD | Trauma Surgeon | Meridian Relief Medical Corps
